slice.slice: Standalone validated fixed-correspondence GICP 3D-residual linearization in Rust core and Python, with indexed row parallelism and serial ordered accumulation. No odometry/ICP solver or matching/default change.
slice.api: core gicp::linearize(correspondences, pose, center_world, parallel); Python gicp_linearization(source,target,source_shapes,target_shapes,pose,center_world,*,weights=None,parallel=False). All arrays are copied/owned. No neighbor inference, hidden fallback, damping, eigenvalue repair, state update or covariance/quality gate in this API.
slice.frames: Source point and source shape are in source sensor frame; target point and target shape are in world frame. C = C_target + R C_source R.T, q = pose(source), r=q-target. Parameters are translation xyz then world rotation xyz about explicit fixed center_world; J=[I,-[q-center]x].
slice.system: Hold correspondences, external nonnegative weights and transported C fixed during linearization. Cholesky whitening L^-1r and L^-1J forms H=sum(w J.T C^-1 J), b=-sum(w J.T C^-1 r), cost=.5 sum(w r.T C^-1 r). This is a fixed-metric surrogate, not the Hessian/gradient of an objective differentiating C(R), matches or robust weights.
slice.validation: Finite proper rigid pose (orthogonality/determinant tolerance 1e-10), finite center/points and finite nonnegative scalar weights. Each shape finite, symmetric within 1e-12 times max absolute entry, canonicalize by symmetric average, and require strict positive Cholesky pivots without a floor. Validate even zero-weight rows. Reject indexed nonfinite arithmetic/overflow rather than repair. Empty batch gives owned empty arrays and zero system. Serial/parallel failures identify the same first source row.
slice.numerics: Independent per-row work may run in indexed Rayon; reduce in original input order. Serial and parallel results must match all output bits and first-error indices. Source/target shape validation and combined whitening use no explicit inverse.
slice.tests: Independent NumPy/SciPy SPD systems and Cholesky, central differences of residuals with frozen baseline metric, off-axis rotations, translated world origin, rotated world basis and source reparameterization including a lever arm. Identity combined metric agrees with P2P. Invalid/asymmetric/indefinite/singular/nonfinite matrices, overflow, zero weights, input/output ownership and parallel-first-error checks.
slice.real_inputs: Reuse the frozen PR295 four 64-scan actual final-pose correspondences, sources and canonical insertion points. Replay the original map. Do not rerun/adopt new poses or parse reference trajectories.

real_shape_model.scatter: Centered arithmetic-mean local PCA using exact cKDTree nearest neighbors, workers=1; source neighbors from all selected source_sensor points, target neighbors from the full replayed pre-insertion map.
real_shape_model.support: Require second eigenvalue > 1e-12 times largest eigenvalue; drop unsupported pairs explicitly in both compared systems. No normal planarity selection or identity fallback.
real_shape_model.matrix: I + (.001-1) n n.T using smallest-eigenvalue unit normal. Normalized surface shape, not calibrated measurement uncertainty.
real_shape_model.weights: Reuse native captured Euclidean GMC weights on retained actual correspondences without change. Do not compare numerical cost magnitudes between different residual metrics as accuracy.

slice.real_comparison: Compare GICP and P2P on exactly the same retained pairs/weights; identity control C_source=C_target=.5I must agree with independent P2P system. NumPy rebuilds C, H, b and cost independently. Native serial/parallel all bits equal. No solve, inversion for state updates, state adoption, new trajectory, default/gate change, timing, GPU or physical accuracy claim.
slice.geometry: Use same retained-weight RMS radius r about the captured prediction center and D=diag(1,1,1,1/r,1/r,1/r). Compare signed eigvalsh(sym(D H D)/sum_w), weak ratio <1e-3, no spectrum without positive support and radius. Shape anisotropy scale is arbitrary; these are uncalibrated conditional diagnostics.
slice.regression: Private full native package frozen before build. Existing native Python suite, unchanged full-motion 660-scan component and 185-scan frontend controllers. Preserve prior protocols, receipts and snapshots byte for byte. Baseline frontend files remain identical.

scope: Declared normalized surface shapes on fixed actual matches only; no trajectory, solver, covariance calibration, physical observability/accuracy, timing, GPU or state adoption.
